'''Ancients''' are mysterious beings that offer boons to the player at the start of each {{2|Act}}. Ancients generally have to be unlocked before being able to meet them during a run (see also: {{2|Timeline}}). There are a total of 8 Ancients in the game. Most Ancients have different "pools" of relics, with only 1 relic out of each pool able to be offered. Compared to the {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Boss|Boss Relics}} in ''Slay the Spire 1'', the player no longer has the ability to skip the choice altogether and instead has to pick one of the options offered.

Upon meeting an Ancient, the player is healed to full health ({{Asc2|2|80% of their lost health}}). They also briefly converse with the player using character-specific dialogue.

Ancients are a major source of {{2|Enchantments}}, with six ({{KW2|Clone}}, {{KW2|Glam}}, {{KW2|Goopy}}, {{KW2|Imbued}}, {{KW2|Instinct}}, and {{KW2|Tezcatara's Ember}}) being exclusively derived from them. They are also the only way to obtain powerful [[Slay the Spire 2:Cards List|Ancient cards]]. These include the starter card upgrades from Orobas's {{R2|Archaic Tooth}}, the five character specific Ancient cards from Darv's {{R2|Dusty Tome}}, and nine universal cards each from their own relics. Ancients can also allow you to access cards exclusive to other characters (along with the {{E2|Colorful Philosophers}} event), such as through {{R2|Prismatic Gem}} or {{R2|Kaleidoscope}}.

== Effective Probability ==
The Ancients that appear at the start of Acts 2 and 3 are selected with equal probability from two separate pools. Each pool includes all unlocked Ancients specific to that act, and may include Darv if he is unlocked.

=== With Darv Unlocked ===
When unlocked, {{2|Darv}} is added to the Act 2 pool 50% of the time, and is added to the Act 3 pool 50% of the time and only if he was not added to the Act 2 pool. Darv cannot be unlocked without first unlocking Orobas, so any time he is added to an act's pool there will be 4 Ancients in that pool, meaning he will appear in Act 2 in 1 out of 8 runs and in Act 3 in 1 out of 16 runs. If Darv appears in Act 2 he cannot appear in Act 3; on the other hand, if he did not appear in Act 2, he may still have been added to the Act 2 pool, and will only appear in Act 3 in 1 out of 14 runs after another Ancient appeared in Act 2. Darv can be unlocked without first unlocking Orobas by joining a multi-player game and seeing Orobas as the Act 2 Ancient.
